title: Ship a Tooltip component and move every native title tooltip onto it
foundBy: the repository owner, deciding how to fix CUI-008
details:
The kit has no tooltip component and uses the browser's native `title` attribute instead. `Table` attaches one on hover, and only when the text is actually cut off, by comparing `scrollWidth` against `clientWidth`. `patterns/DataTable.md` documents that as the expected behaviour, so it is a decision rather than an oversight.

A native `title` never appears on keyboard focus. Tab to a truncated row and there is no way to read the full text, so the affordance exists for mouse users alone. It also cannot be styled, cannot be dismissed, and disappears if the pointer moves onto it.

One nuance decides the design. When text is truncated with an ellipsis the full string is still in the DOM, so a screen reader already reads it. A tooltip repeating it must therefore be hidden from assistive technology or the name is announced twice. A tooltip carrying new information must be announced. The component needs both modes and the caller picks.

Agreed shape: shows on hover after a delay and on keyboard focus immediately, dismissible with Escape, stays open when the pointer moves onto it, and no collision detection in this pass. That is the WCAG 1.4.13 bar for content on hover or focus.

Every existing `title` used as a tooltip moves onto it in the same pass, so the kit ends with one mechanism rather than two.

notes.text: Filed before building, at the repository owner's direction, after they chose the accessible scope and a full retrofit over a staged one. Driven by CUI-008, which needs somewhere to put the full text once a Tree label is cut.
